title: Professional facial cleansing
what: A beautician cleans the skin of the face of dirt and blackheads. Cleansing can be manual, by device, or a mix.
why: When the face has enlarged pores, blackheads, or the skin is oily or dull.
tell_doctor: If your skin has inflammation, a rash, or a cold sore
If you take acne medicines or hormones
If you recently had a peel or injections

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Better not to sunbathe or use scrubs.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: You can come with makeup, and it will be removed, but it is better without.

bring: Your own hair tie or headband, if you like
steps: Makeup is removed from your skin
The skin is steamed or a softening product is applied
The beautician removes blackheads with gloved hands or a device
Your skin is treated with a soothing product
At the end, a mask and cream are applied
feel: Manual cleansing can be unpleasant and painful in places
Afterward, redness, usually for a few hours
after: On the first day, better with no makeup
1 to 2 days with no sauna, pool, or scrubs
Do not touch your face with your hands
red_flags: Many pimples with pus, heavy swelling, or pain after 1 to 2 days

faq.q: How often can I have cleansing?
faq.a: Usually not more than once a month. A beautician will advise based on your skin.

faq.q: Why did I break out after cleansing?
faq.a: Sometimes this happens for 1 to 2 days. If there are many breakouts and they hurt, show them to the beautician.

reminders.text: Facial cleansing tomorrow. No scrubs or sun today.
